MENU.Name: Configure Defaults
MENU.Label: Configure Defaults
MENU.Title: Token Defaults Configuration

Apply.Label: Apply Defaults
Apply.Title: Apply Defaults
Apply.Warning: Make sure you save any changes before applying. This will apply these settings to all your Actors or Tokens that exist in your world.

MENU.Hint: These Settings apply to all types of Actors. If a specifc Actor type also has one of those settings, the specific one will be prioritized.

Confirm.Label: Reset Defaults
Confirm.Warning: This will remove all configured Token Defaults

TOKEN_CREATE.Name: Tokens
TOKEN_CREATE.Hint: Apply the Defaults to newly created Tokens. The "Append Number" and "Prepend Adjective" Settings do not exist on Tokens and are ignored.

ACTOR_CREATE.Name: Prototype Tokens
ACTOR_CREATE.Hint: Apply the Defaults to the Prototype Tokens of newly created Actors in your world.

COMPENDIUM.Name: Compendium Actors
COMPENDIUM.Hint: Apply the Defaults to the Prototype Tokens of newly created Actors in compendiums.
